Chapter 6214: Heaven Bewitched Formation

Chapter 6214: Heaven Bewitched Formation

The four youths stared at the fog before glancing at each other.

"We made it this far, I feel like ghosts may be real." Mu Hu said.

This was because they could sense an ominous presence waiting beyond the veil. After taking one step inside, a ghost hand might touch their shoulder. This dreadful feeling made them shudder.

"It's alright, just something fiendish." Princess Chen said: "Or because of remnant powers leaking from the void storms."

"It's a possibility if this place leads to the old battlefields." Monk Zhu said.

"Haha, we're done with talking?" Black Witch Monarch said: "I have taken you to the right spot, you decide now."

"Aren't you coming in as well? Exorcism was your initial purpose." She said.

"Child, who are you underestimating? I do not fear this little ghost, fine, I will lead the way again and show you how it's done." He spat on the ground.

They ignored him and knew he might be the first to run despite his strong rhetoric.

"Should we?" She asked.

"This is a grand formation, we have to break it first before entering." Orchidcore said.

"Does your clan have a way to break or nullify it?" Princess Chen asked Li Xian.

"If we had one, we no longer have access to it." Li Xian said.

"Formation is not my forte, I can't be of use." Orchidcore shook his head.

"Let me check it out then." Monk Zhu stepped forward.

"Amitabha." He chanted with his palms placed together and a Buddhist plate appeared behind his head.

His Buddhist affinity filled the air, making him look like a holy Buddha.

"How strong." Li Xian staggered backward and hid behind Li Qiye.

Due to his weak cultivation, the affinity alone might convert him to Buddhism.

"Merciful Buddha." Monk Zhu chanted and the plate flew into the unknown.

The fog and mist immediately coiled around it, wishing to block its sight. Monk Zhu didn't relent and fiery light came from his eyes.

The plate emitted echoes of Buddhism and summoned Buddhist eyes. They lit up like suns and attempted to dispel the fog.

"Illusory Break!" He formed a mudra and channeled his power to the limit.

The solar eyes turned into maelstroms, intensifying the process.

"Oh? This monk's illusory break is not bad at all." The monarch praised, albeit leaving the sincerity factor unclear.

"Bam!" A dragon roar detonated and the fog destroyed the eyes. The plate shattered next.

"Ugh." Monk Zhu staggered backward and vomited a mouthful of blood.

"Are you okay?" The other three came and helped him up.

"I'm fine, this isn't an ordinary formation though, it's created by the Li's progenitor, the name is Heaven Bewitched." The monk said.

"So this is Heaven Bewitched?" Li Xian murmured.

"Did she personally set it up?" Princess Chen asked while staring at the fog.

"I don't know, but we can't break it." Monk Zhu said.

Thus, they turned toward the monarch.

"Hahaha, I'm not good with formation either. Looks like we won't be catching ghosts today. It's time to give up." The monarch waved his hand.

"What? Giving up when we just got here?" Orchidcore was confused.

"Is there another option when we can't break the formation? Might as well go home and take a nap." He laughed and turned to leave.

However, Li Qiye grabbed his arm and pulled him back.

"Young Noble, what's happening?" He asked with a sad expression.

The young ones watched in confusion. Why did the monarch respect the weakest cultivator here?

"Let's not waste our trip here." Li Qiye said.

"Young Noble, it's not up to me, this formation is just unbreakable so this is the end of the game, don't you think?" The monarch said with a smile.

"Who says it is unbreakable?" Li Qiye replied.

"Then please break it, Young Noble." The monarch asked.

On the other hand, the four young ones had no faith in Li Qiye. Of course, they weren't looking down on Li Qiye since they themselves couldn't break it.
